description: Tanning Rack Item Level 28 Requires Leatherworking (140) Use: Places a Tanning Rack that allows the creation of certain reagents, and provides all of the benefits of a Camp Tent. Requires a Campfire nearby. May be placed over a Camp Tent to replace it. All camping features share a cooldown of 1 hour. (1 Hour Cooldown) Max Stack: 20
